fusions.name: Flung Gauntlet
fusions.desc: Throws a gauntlet at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 11 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gap in the Lames
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Glancing Angle
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 9 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Turned Blows
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
